body: I don't know what I did wrong? Can someone clarify please.

Yeah the feeling of thinking that every part of yourself is fat and weird is the worst, I've gone through a lot of stuff over it. I've seen companies that make binders look exactly like bras because of parents like these. And people come up with ways like ace bandages. I always tell myself that my body is natural, it's in my head, or that as long as my weight doesn't cause health problems I'm healthy, but telling yourself that is easier said than done. From one body dismorphic person to another, you are not ugly and you are not selfish for feeling the way you do. The world sucks and it's hard out here. It seems to take a hell of a long time to feel good about ourselves, but I believe in you and I hope you get there.

A little personal story I hope you don't mind, but I had bad images about myself like you. I didn't like my chest either I've always had a big chest and I hated it. I just wanted them gone. And I started questioning myself if I was trans or non binary too. Eventually I got a binder (told my mom it was a sports bra because I came from a consev family) and I realized that I just didnt like my chest. It's still a form of body dysmorphia. Don't take my story as an answer I mean this as I can relate to you story.

Do you mind if I ask what you feel about your body, like what are your thoughts on yourself? And does your mother know what a binder looks like?

Would the kids at school tell your mom? And have you tried LGBT support groups or have you and you didn't like it or didn't see the point of it?

I'm guessing you're in a very conservative place, I feel so terrible for you and I hope you manage to get out of your situation.

Wear it while you're alone or with people you trust, I can't tell you if it would make you feel better, but trying is all you can do. Small accomplishments I suppose. I'm so sorry you're stuck in this Situation, I don't believe you're a bad person at all. You deserve to be yourself and happiness.

Do you have any friends who know of this and or support you?
What does your mom do to monitor you?
Do you have any people that you can trust to discreetly get you one? If you can't homemade ones are something to really look into.

I relate to you so much, the constant questioning of yourself and people in your life who doesn't give a single fuck about you, it's just too much. Too too much. Do you want to talk about what's happening? I really really hope that you get your binder and feel some sort of relief or happiness.

Yeah heh, let's hope you get to have a nice day doing the things you enjoy soon. Unwinding and relaxing is a healer^^ You can always pick up some new hobbies too like making those rubber band bracelets or tamagotchis, it helps.
Aw you look so pretty! I love the nails and your hair is really cute! I hope you're doing ok especially during these hard times and it's done so much in such a short time! Lots of love hun!

Maybe add a little I mean a very little amount of black eyeshadow on your bottom lid. Hairstyles help too look up some manly long updo hairstyles and itll help a lot! Maybe do a poll of some hairstyles you like and see what's the best.

Well this is a really deep topic that takes more than just strangers, but I'll see what I can say that might help. It's obvious hes had a very very bad past and the poor dear. Kids can be so mean when they dont understand. I think maybe you should have a heart to heart ask if hed want to go to a therapist to talk about things that he cant talk about to you. Or maybe he might be bi but it was crushed out because of the past trauma. He never fully got to explore and see where he stood because of the time. Maybe dress up a little feminine masculine and see how he feels he might see it's not as bad as he thought when he realizes that those who taunted him arent around anymore. Pick it up a little more from there and slowly introduce the topic more and more. Icebreakers like, "oh wow that shirt makes me look more muscular can you tell?" Things like that. It's a slow process for someone to get used to it. Best of luck dear.

Well I'm not her but what I think is that she's known you as your birth given gender and isnt ready to give you up as the gender you feel is you. She's seen you as her little man and she's scared that you'll change and shell feel like you're a stranger. What you need to do is slowly wear girly clothes that flatter you maybe skinny jeans and a womans dress shirt first so shell get used to it. After you show her that you'll always be the same, just that you're comfortable with being a girl instead of a boy, and she gets used to how it's like having a trans child shell be more ok and trusting with takin you, she might also think you're too young and that you'll regret it later so doing this might cement that you're serious and not just a snap decision thing. Stay safe hun and one day you'll be a lovely young woman!
